intake.decision_clock: Standard review. Pharmacy benefit: 72 hours; medical benefit: 7 calendar days, from receipt of all required information (policy section E).

notes: Two submissions: iv induction via the medical benefit; sc maintenance via the pharmacy benefit

indications: Moderately to severely active Crohn's disease (adults 18+)
Moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis (adults 18+)

criteria.text: The member has moderately to severely active Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis, as stated by the prescriber in the clinical record.
evidence_needed: Prescriber's statement in the clinical record of a CD or UC diagnosis
Prescriber's statement that the disease is moderately to severely active

criteria.text: Disease activity is confirmed by direct visualization: an ileocolonoscopy, colonoscopy, or flexible sigmoidoscopy done within the past 12 months that documents active mucosal inflammation. Lab markers (including fecal calprotectin, C-reactive protein and sedimentation rate) do not meet this requirement on their own. Cross-sectional imaging studies do not meet it either.
evidence_needed: Ileocolonoscopy, colonoscopy, or flexible sigmoidoscopy report dated within 12 months before the request
Report findings documenting active mucosal inflammation

criteria.text: The prescriber is a gastroenterologist, or the prescriber has consulted with a gastroenterologist about this treatment.
evidence_needed: Prescriber specialty showing gastroenterology, OR
Documentation of a consultation with a gastroenterologist about ustekinumab treatment

criteria.text: The member is at least 18 years old on the date of the request. Members under 18 are not covered by this policy and are reviewed case by case by a Calder Mutual pharmacist.
evidence_needed: Member date of birth
Date of request

criteria.text: The member has tried at least one prior therapy for CD or UC, shown by either (a) or (b). One is enough. The record should identify the drug, roughly when it was used, and why it was stopped. A trial of a TNF blocker before ustekinumab is not required.
evidence_needed: Name of the prior drug
Approximate dates of use
Reason the drug was stopped or found insufficient

sub_criteria.text: A conventional agent (an oral or IV corticosteroid, budesonide, azathioprine, mercaptopurine, or methotrexate; for UC only, also an oral 5-aminosalicylate) was stopped or found insufficient because of inadequate response, intolerance, or contraindication.
evidence_needed: Name of the conventional agent (for an oral 5-aminosalicylate, the diagnosis must be UC)
Approximate dates of use
Documented reason: inadequate response, intolerance, or contraindication

sub_criteria.text: A biologic or targeted synthetic agent for CD or UC (for example adalimumab, infliximab, vedolizumab, certolizumab, risankizumab, tofacitinib, upadacitinib, ozanimod) was stopped or found insufficient because of inadequate response or intolerance, OR there is a documented contraindication to TNF blockers.
evidence_needed: Name of the biologic or targeted synthetic agent, with approximate dates of use and a documented reason of inadequate response or intolerance, OR
A documented contraindication to TNF blockers

criteria.text: Tuberculosis screening with an interferon-gamma release assay or tuberculin skin test gave a negative result within the past 6 months. An indeterminate or borderline result does not count as negative. A member with a positive screen qualifies only if the record shows a chest radiograph without active disease AND that treatment for latent TB infection has begun.
evidence_needed: IGRA or TST result dated within 6 months before the request
Result is negative (not indeterminate or borderline), OR, if positive: a chest radiograph showing no active disease and documentation that latent TB treatment has started

criteria.text: Hepatitis B status is documented with results for both hepatitis B surface antigen and total hepatitis B core antibody. The results may be of any age. A reactive result requires a documented plan for antiviral prophylaxis or monitoring. Surface antibody results and vaccination records are not enough. Pending orders are not enough.
evidence_needed: Resulted HBsAg test (not just a pending order)
Resulted total anti-HBc test (not just a pending order)
If either result is reactive: a documented plan for antiviral prophylaxis or monitoring

criteria.text: Ustekinumab will not be combined with any other biologic, JAK inhibitor, or S1P receptor modulator for CD or UC. If the member is switching from one of these agents, the record shows the earlier agent is being stopped.
evidence_needed: Current medication list showing no other biologic, JAK inhibitor, or S1P receptor modulator for CD/UC to be used at the same time
If switching: documentation that the earlier agent is being stopped

criteria.text: The requested regimen is the labeled adult regimen: one weight-based IV induction infusion (260 mg for weight up to and including 55 kg; 390 mg for weight above 55 kg up to and including 85 kg; 520 mg for weight above 85 kg), then 90 mg subcutaneously every 8 weeks starting 8 weeks after the infusion. A body weight recorded within the 90 days before the request must be on file.
evidence_needed: Body weight recorded within 90 days before the request
Requested IV induction dose that matches the weight band
Requested maintenance dose of 90 mg SC every 8 weeks, starting 8 weeks after the infusion

assessments.reasoning: The GI note of 2026-11-04 states moderately to severely active ileocolonic Crohn's disease. A Harvey-Bradshaw Index of 14 supports active disease.

evidence.quote: - Terminal ileum: multiple ulcers 0.3-1.5 cm with surrounding erythema and edema.

assessments.reasoning: The colonoscopy on 2026-10-11 is about 1 month before the request, well inside the 12-month window. It documents ileal ulcers with erythema and edema and an SES-CD of 15, which is active mucosal inflammation seen directly.

The QuantiFERON-TB Gold Plus result is negative, dated 2026-09-12. That is about 2 months before the request, inside the 6-month window.
Both HBsAg and total anti-HBc have results and both are nonreactive. Because neither is reactive, no prophylaxis or monitoring plan is needed.

evidence.quote: - Start ustekinumab-ttwe: 390 mg IV once (weight 66.0 kg), then 90 mg subcutaneously every 8 weeks starting 8 weeks after the IV dose.

assessments.reasoning: The weight of 66.0 kg was recorded on 2026-11-04, within 90 days of the request, and falls in the above-55 to 85 kg band, which calls for 390 mg IV. The 90 mg SC every 8 weeks maintenance, starting 8 weeks after the infusion, matches the labeled regimen.
